title: ProtoPur: Prototype-Purity Pseudo-Labeling for Weakly Supervised Instance Learning in Pathology
abstract: arXiv:2610.15669v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Weak bag-level labels are widely available in computational pathology, whereas reliable instance-level annotations for whole-slide images remain expensive and ambiguous. Weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) achieves strong bag-level classification, but instance-level supervision from attention scores, model predictions, negative bags, or spatial refinement may fail to identify class-specific local evidence. We propose ProtoPur, a prototype-purity pseudo-labeling method for weakly supervised instance-level learning in pathology whole-slide images. ProtoPur estimates class-balanced local purity over prototype regions constructed from frozen foundation-model features, and assigns pseudo-labels to high-purity regions strongly associated with a target class. This purity-first design separates class-specific evidence from negative or shared morphology, with coverage used only to ensure sufficient pseudo-label assignment

translated_title: ProtoPur：面向病理学弱监督实例学习的原型纯度伪标签方法
translated_abstract: 在计算病理学中，弱袋级标签广泛可得，而全切片图像的可靠实例级标注仍然昂贵且存在歧义。弱监督多示例学习在袋级分类上表现优异，但基于注意力分数、模型预测、负样本袋或空间优化的实例级监督方法可能无法识别类别特定的局部证据。我们提出了ProtoPur，一种用于病理全切片图像弱监督实例级学习的原型纯度伪标签方法。ProtoPur基于冻结的基础模型特征构建原型区域，并在这些区域上估计类别平衡的局部纯度，进而为与目标类别强相关的高纯度区域分配伪标签。这种“纯度优先”的设计将类别特定证据与阴性或共享的形态学特征区分开来，而覆盖率仅用于确保充足的伪标签分配。
tldr: 提出ProtoPur方法，通过基于冻结基础模型特征构建原型区域并估计类别平衡的局部纯度，为高纯度区域分配伪标签，从而实现病理全切片图像的弱监督实例级学习。
en_tdlr: ProtoPur introduces a purity-first pseudo-labeling approach that estimates class-balanced local purity over prototype regions built from frozen foundation-model features, enabling effective weakly supervised instance-level learning in pathology whole-slide images.
